pre_forward_refreeze_reason: Oracle A1 deployment seal before any forward marker/observation. The selected persistent host is Ubuntu 24.04 ARM64 on VM.Standard.A1.Flex, right-sized to 1 OCPU/1 GB with swap only for install/recovery headroom. Runtime enforcement binds CPython 3.12 minor, Linux/ARM64, and exact websockets transport version while recording the Python patch version informationally so normal 3.12.x security updates/replacement hosts do not invalidate V1. The enforced implementation hash covers only files that can affect live observations/accounting; bootstrap/recovery helpers and CI-only workflow changes cannot halt a healthy tournament. Frozen-state mismatch uses a permanent systemd exit status to prevent restart loops. Oracle bootstrap/recovery, repo-scoped write-key flow, exact-host preflight, and missed-checkpoint-no-replay semantics are finalized.
